title: Similarity and Right-Triangle Trig: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Similar figures have the same shape and proportional sides. That idea powers indirect measurement, and in right triangles it leads to sine, cosine and tangent.

blocks.title: Similarity tests
items: AA: two pairs of equal angles
SAS: two equal ratios and the angle between

blocks.body: Use degree mode on your calculator. The second acute angle of a right triangle is $90^\circ$ minus the first.
